I will do mostly what I did before on a small piece like this. This plot is very small, so I will not spend big money on many inputs, but because it is my own land I will put some manure and a little fertilizer when I can get it, the same way I have seen work on other people’s maize. I will keep local seed from home because buying hybrid for such a small intercropped plot is hard on cash, and I will use family work instead of paying many ganyu people.
